model: per usercmd, after M2 AirAccelerate, on any command with a new bit in buttons & 0x618 (FORWARD|BACK|MOVELEFT|MOVERIGHT): lam = 0.7*clamp01((0.5 - t)/0.3), t from the start of the latest jump command (ground, slide or wall-bounce jump); d = normalize((1-lam)*vhat + lam*wishdir); D = |v| d - v; |D| <= 209.3 per press; v += D

t_zero_s.note: A1 fade presses imply the window edges are about 0.5 ms later than the start-to-start sum of dt; inside the M3 +-1 ms, model not changed

clamp_ups.note: 0.7 x sprint cap 299 (movescale 1.15); M4 showed it scales with the sprint cap

wishdir.value: normalize(fwd*forward + side*right) from the command's own view yaw

anchor.value: latest jump command incl. wall bounce

budget_cooldown.value: none observed (presses 2 commands apart all lurch fully)
